semiconductor_relevance: High — MCL Electronic Materials Co., Ltd is a key supplier of silicon wafers, which are fundamental to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: MCL Electronic Materials Co., Ltd, based in Luoyang, China, is a leading manufacturer of Czochralski-grown monocrystalline silicon and silicon wafers. The company produces high-quality circuit-grade polished wafers in sizes of 5-inch, 6-inch, and 8-inch, adhering to rigorous quality and environmental standards.
capabilities: TS16949 and IATF16949:2016 certified manufacturing processes
technical_expertise: Quality management systems in semiconductor manufacturing

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Luoyang, China, with manufacturing facilities specializing in silicon wafer production.
